description.en: Plugins maintained by c3115644151 for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: c3115644151 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护的插件。

description.en: Reads the GitHub repositories a session subscribes to and keeps only the events that concern you — failed checks, reviews waiting for you, issues assigned to you, comments that mention you — then injects them at the next turn boundary. A chip in the status row lists them and switches delivery, message clearing and subscriptions. Read-only, no turn on its own, no request while idle.
description.zh: 按会话订阅的 GitHub 仓库，只保留与你有关、需要你处理的事件（失败的 CI、待你评审的 PR、指派给你的 issue、@你的评论），在回合边界注入会话上下文。状态行里的胶囊可查看待处理项，并切换提醒方式、消息清理与订阅仓库。只读 GitHub，默认不主动开启对话，空闲时不发请求。
